findings.message: Root composition is missing `data-width` or `data-height`.
findings.fixHint: Set numeric `data-width` and `data-height` on the entry composition root.

findings.message: Missing `window.__timelines` registration.
findings.fixHint: Register each composition timeline on `window.__timelines[compositionId]`.

findings.message: <div data-composition-id="ch-02"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.

findings.message: Root composition has no data-duration, no GSAP timeline, and no CSS/WAAPI/Lottie/Three.js animation for the runtime to infer a duration from. The render engine cannot determine how long to capture and will fail with "Composition has zero duration".
findings.fixHint: Add data-duration="<seconds>" to the root element, or add a paused GSAP timeline registered on window.__timelines.

findings.message: The default index.html composition has no renderable content, but compositions/ch-01.html, compositions/ch-02.html, compositions/ch-03.html contains a standalone timed composition. Default check, snapshot, preview, render, and publish commands open index.html, so they will capture or publish only its background.
findings.fixHint: Move the authored composition into index.html, or mount it from index.html with data-composition-src and the sub-composition <template> contract. If the separate file is intentional, render it explicitly with --composition compositions/ch-01.html.
